getAIDetails.prototype = Object.extendsObject(global.AbstractAjaxProcessor, {
	getDetails:function(){
		let userDetails = {};
		var nameID = this.getParameter('sysparm_ai_details');
		gs.addErrorMessage(nameID);
		var gr = new GlideRecord('ai_devices');
			// gr.addQuery('sys_id', nameID);
			// gr.query();
			if(gr.get(nameID)){
				userDetails.model = gr.getDisplayValue('model_number');
				userDetails.desc = gr.getDisplayValue('short_description');
				userDetails.price = gr.getDisplayValue('u_price_3');
				userDetails.warranty = gr.getDisplayValue('warranty_expiration');
			}
			return JSON.stringify(userDetails);
	},
    type: 'getAIDetails'
